e2_status: N/A here: this registry exists for the beta sweep and the novelty anchor; tau_F is measured by experiments/s4_meta_loop.py
provenance: built by experiments/build_arxiv_concepts.py from export.arxiv.org OAI-PMH; complete subject slices rather than relevance samples, so there is no expansion cone to be blind outside of; raw pages and digests are under each corpus manifest
note_on_T: each snapshot carries its own cut year: ds harvests from 2012 and cuts at the kernel pin 2017; cl harvests from mid-2015 and cuts at 2020 so that both the pre-T side (counterexample decline) and the post-T side (realization) have five years. Realization rates are therefore never compared across corpora, only each arm against its own matched chance within one corpus.
note_on_v2: the -v2 snapshots re-read the same recorded harvests under the noun-phrases-v1 label discipline (see extras/arxiv.py): verb inflections, number words, generic adjectives and discourse adverbs now break phrase runs, which removed 13.8% of the ds vocabulary and 16.3% of the cl vocabulary and replaced seeds like 'least one' and 'improved bound' with 'max cut' and 'optimal value'. The v1 snapshots stay because the archived p1/p2/p3 readings are measured in their pair space and must stay replayable.
